Class EnvironmentSettings

Namespace
HiveSync.Utilities.Settings
Assembly
HiveSync.Utilities.dll

Represents environment-specific configuration values used by the application, primarily for frontend integration and email communication.

Remarks

This class is typically bound from application configuration (e.g., appsettings.json) and injected using the options pattern.

Properties

FrontendConfirmUrl

Gets or sets the relative URL path used for email confirmation.

public required string FrontendConfirmUrl { get; set; }

Property Value

string

Remarks

This value is appended to FrontendHostUrl when constructing confirmation links sent via email. Example: "/auth/confirm".

FrontendHostUrl

Gets or sets the base URL of the frontend application.

public required string FrontendHostUrl { get; set; }

Property Value

string

Remarks

Used when generating absolute links (e.g., email confirmation links). Example: "https://app.hivesync.io".

SenderEmail

Gets or sets the email address used as the sender for outgoing emails.

public required string SenderEmail { get; set; }

Property Value

string

Remarks

This address appears in the "From" field of system-generated emails.

SenderName

Gets or sets the display name used as the sender name for outgoing emails.

public required string SenderName { get; set; }

Property Value

string

Remarks

This value appears alongside SenderEmail in the "From" field.
